title: Synthetic Studio for Example Client
dek: A synthetic panel, grounded in your own research data, that answers a concept question in hours instead of weeks.

cta.label: Book a working session
cta.title: Start with a two-week working session
cta.text: We agree the question, the data access and the success measures before any build.

cards: Synthetic respondents grounded in your survey and CRM data, refreshed each quarter.
A workspace where your researchers design a study, run it and compare segments.
Every finding links to the responses behind it, so it can be challenged.

steps: Agree the business question and what a useful answer looks like.
Ground the panel in your data and validate it against a past study.
Field the three pilot studies with your brand teams.
Review the readouts and choose whether to extend.

blocks.callout: Illustrative. Figures and names on this page are examples, not client data.
